name: Evidence Interaction Hinge
ascii:
Legend: `[D]` = data/state, `(O)` = operation. Source symbols appear in code style.

                         EVIDENCE INTERACTION HINGE

(O) Mapped Representation Element -> Evidence
    `AsciiSelectionGrid` / `App.revealCodeEntity`
                                      |
                                      | activate `DiagramElementMapping`
                                      v
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [D] EvidenceEntity - user-interaction hinge                                |
|     stable `id`, handle, label, kind, summary                              |
|     one or more `SourceRange` anchors                                      |
|                                                                            |
| (O) Inspect Evidence and choose SourceRange                                |
|     `CodeEntitiesPanel`: metadata and `@entity` handle                     |
|     choose `path:line`; reveal selects entity and range                    |
|     `referenceResolver.ts`: stable `sourceRangeId`, legacy range index     |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+

[D] EvidenceEntity <--- (O) EvidenceSchema.fromCodeEntity --- [D] persisted CodeEntityRecord
    `src/domainProfile.ts` | `src/domainProfiles.ts` | `src/domain.ts SourceRange`

Required grounding: Representation -> Evidence -> Corpus.
Direct Corpus access is reserved for explicit browsing.

                         active Evidence + chosen range
                                      |
                                      v
(O) Evidence -> Authoritative Corpus Reveal
    `CodeEntitiesPanel` / `server/application.ts Application.sourceSnippet`
    validate range; read project document; overlay immutable anchored snapshot
                                      |
                                      v
[D] Authoritative Corpus Passage
    source or Markdown presentation

                         EVIDENCE-CENTERED INTERACTIONS

(O) File Paths Group Evidence
    `fileTree.ts diagramFileFilter` / `FileExplorerPanel`
       |
       | normalized `SourceRange.path`; exact entity/range selection
       v
[D] Selected Evidence / Range

[D] stable Representation element + [D] selected Evidence/range
       |
       v
(O) Persistent Evidence-backed Highlight
    `HighlightRecordV2`: artifact revision, element, Evidence/range, excerpt, lineage
    `src/highlights.ts` / `Application.addHighlight` / `App.revealHighlight`

(O) Rectangle Selection -> Evidence References
    `AsciiSelectionGrid` / `DiagramView.completeSelection`
       |
       | intersect mappings; preview resolved, source-range-aware references
       v
[D] DiagramSet-scoped RefBuffer
    `refBuffer.ts` / `RefBufferTray`: copy | typed token | dispatch | remove | clear
       |
       | provenance-preserving selected Evidence references
       v
(O) Selected Evidence -> Focused Call Graph
    `src/callGraphFocus.ts createCallGraphFocusRequest`
    server verifies source Diagram, featured relationship, and entity overlap
    result: matching nodes plus connecting ancestors (`filterCallGraphTree`)
